post.summary:
Commenters and up: say something in the board's chat, which everyone on the board reads live from its document.
With `answer`, the model then answers in the chat too, as this person (their role, their selection).

put.summary: Updaters and owners: open a round of dot voting (clearing the last), or close it to show the results.

post.summary: Commenters and up, while a vote runs: add a vote to a note, or take one back. 409 when out of votes.

put.summary: Updaters and owners: start the board's shared timer, or stop it.

post.summary: Updaters and owners: split everyone with the board open across these frames, each group with its own timer.

delete.summary: Updaters and owners: bring everyone back together.

post.summary: Commenters and up: move yourself into a breakout group.

put.summary: Updaters and owners: start or stop one group's timer.

post.summary: Updaters and owners: take the facilitator's seat (owners can take it from someone).
The facilitator: bring everyone's view to this.

get.summary: The workspace's folders, by name.

post.summary: Updaters and owners of the workspace: a new folder.

put.summary: Updaters and owners of the board: file it in a folder, or take it out (null).

get.summary: Board owners: the board's share links, newest first.

post.summary: Board owners: a link that lets anyone who has it view the board, read-only.

delete.summary: Board owners: turn a link off; anyone viewing through it is let go.

get.summary: Anyone with a link: a file on the board it opens, while the link is live (410 after).
Anyone with a link: what it opens. 410 once it's turned off or expired.
Anyone on the board: what happened on it, newest first; only after `since` (epoch ms) when given.
Anyone on the board: its saved versions, newest first.

post.summary: Updaters and owners: save the board as it is now.

get.summary: Anyone on the board: a version's content (a Yjs update), to look at before restoring it.

post.summary: Updaters and owners: bring a version back for everyone (what's there now is saved first).

get.summary:
A live stream (server-sent events) that says "changed" the moment you have a new notification; fetch the list
then. A "ping" every 25 seconds keeps proxies from closing it.
Your latest notifications, newest first.

post.summary: Marks some (or all) of your notifications read.

get.summary: Whether the development picker is on, so the sign-in page knows what to offer.

post.summary: Signing up, step one: the options for the browser to make a passkey with.
Signing up, step two: the new passkey. Makes the account and signs in.
Signing in, step one: a challenge for any of this site's passkeys.
Signing in, step two: the passkey's signature.
Ends this browser's session.

get.summary: Your passkeys.

post.summary: Adding a passkey on another device, step one.
Adding a passkey, step two.

delete.summary: Removes one of your passkeys (not the last).

post.summary: Updaters and owners: add an image or file (up to 10 MB) to the board; place it with the returned id.

get.summary: Anyone who can open the board: the file itself. Images and PDFs open in place; other files download.

post.summary: Commenters and up: ask one of the workspace's models about an image on the board, and places marked on it.
Commenters and up: react to a note or frame with one of a few emoji, or take it back.
Commenters and up: has a model summarise the board, saved in the board for everyone. 502 when the model fails.
Commenters and up: a model writes the session's decisions, actions and open questions, posted to the board's chat.
Updaters and owners: start a hidden writing round. 409 if one is running.

delete.summary: Updaters and owners: end the round without revealing; its notes are thrown away.

post.summary: Updaters and owners: put every note from the round on the board, and end it.

get.summary: Commenters and up: your notes in the running round. Nobody else's.

post.summary: Commenters and up, while a round runs: write a hidden note.
Anyone signed in: the title, description and picture of a public web page, for a link card.

get.summary: Anyone in the workspace: its issue trackers (never their tokens).

post.summary: Workspace owners: connect GitHub, Linear or Jira.
Updaters and owners: send the board's open tasks (or these) to a tracker; each remembers its issue.

get.summary: Workspace owners: the last 30 days, board by board, and what the models cost.
Workspace owners: everything in the workspace as one JSON file to download (never keys or tokens).

delete.summary: Workspace owners: delete the workspace and everything in it, typing its name to confirm.

post.summary: Updaters and owners: take back one of the model's changes (see the board's `ledger`). 409 if it's already undone.
Updaters and owners: put an undone change back. 409 if it isn't undone.

get.summary: Every comment thread on the board, resolved ones included.

post.summary: Commenters and up: comment on a note or frame. Returns its thread.

patch.summary: Commenters and up: resolve a thread, or reopen it.

delete.summary: Its author, or a board owner: delete a comment.

get.summary: Ready when Postgres answers.

post.summary: Adds someone to pick; their id is then their bearer token.

get.summary: The workspace's boards the person can open, most recently changed first.

post.summary: Updaters and owners of the workspace: a new board, blank or from a template, which they own.

get.summary: The boards a new one can start from.

post.summary:
Updaters and owners: the next session's board. It has the same frames, the tasks not yet done, and their notes; it
goes in the same workspace and folder, owned by whoever started it.

delete.summary: Board owners: delete the board, for everyone.

get.summary: Who's in the board's workspace and what each may do on this board.

put.summary: Board owners: give someone a role on this board, or (null) return them to their workspace role.

get.summary: The board's content as last saved, read-only: editing happens over the collaboration socket (/collab).
Boards in the workspace whose title or notes match the query, leaving out any kept from the person.
Everyone in the workspace, and the invites waiting to be accepted.

patch.summary: Owners: change someone's role. The last owner can't step down.

delete.summary: Owners: remove someone. Anyone: leave (their own id). The last owner can't go.

post.summary: Admins: invite an email at a role. Send them the link (/invite/{token}); it's how they join.
What an invite link is for. A POST, so the secret stays out of URLs and logs.
Joins a workspace through an invite link.

get.summary: Invites waiting for the signed-in person (development picker only; see MembersService).
The models this workspace can use.

post.summary: Admins: connect a model.
Admins: check the connection works, with a one-word reply.

Asks one of the workspace's models about the board (or the selected notes), letting it add and recolour notes.
Answers 502 with the model's problem in plain words when the model fails.

info.title: Corkboard API
info.description: Collaborative AI whiteboard backend. Send an access token from the identity provider as a bearer token.

answer.description: Whether the model answers this message (it was @-mentioned, or the sender has it answer everything).

modelId.description: Which of the workspace's models answers; needed when `answer` is set.

noteIds.description: The sender's selected notes, for the model to focus on; without them, the whole board.

open.description: Opens a new round (clearing the last one's votes), or closes the current one.

votesEach.description: Votes each person gets in a new round.

add.description: Adds a vote, or takes one back.

seconds.description: How long, from now; null stops the timer.

label.description: What the time is for, e.g. "Add notes".

frameIds.description: A frame for each group to work in.

minutes.description: Each group's time, if they get a timer.

seconds.description: How long, from now; null stops the group's timer.

folderId.description: The folder to file it in; null to take it out of its folder.

token.description: The secret part of the link: the page's URL is /shared/{token}.

canEdit.description: Whoever has it can change the board, not just look.
Let whoever has the link change the board, not just look.

expiresInDays.description: Days until it stops working; without it, it works until revoked.

expiresAt.description: Epoch ms; null for no expiry.

canEdit.description: The link lets its holder change the board.

by.description: Who saved it; null for the saves made as people edit.

picker.description: The development picker is on: people can pick who they are without signing in.

options.description: WebAuthn options as JSON, for the browser (e.g. @simplewebauthn/browser).

answer.description: The answer to the overall question.

answers.description: Answers about each mark, by its id.

nodeId.description: A note or frame on the board.

on.description: Reacts, or takes the reaction back.

modelId.description: Which of the workspace's models writes it.

sources.description: Ids of the notes it rests on.

fingerprint.description: A hash of every note's content when it was made; the board has moved on when it differs.

modelId.description: Which of the workspace's models writes it.

sources.description: Ids of the notes it rests on.

owner.description: Who does it, as the board names them; absent when nobody's named.

due.description: When, as the board says it ("Friday", "next sprint"), if it does.

model.description: The model's name, and who asked.

anonymous.description: Revealed notes carry no author's name.

frameId.description: A frame to put the notes in when they're revealed; else they go beside the board's notes.

baseUrl.description: Jira: the site, project key, and the email the token belongs to.

target.description: Where issues go, in words: "acme/web", "Linear team", "ENG on acme.atlassian.net".

token.description: A personal access token or API key; stored encrypted and never shown again.

taskIds.description: Which tasks; by default, every one not done and not sent before.

taskKey.description: The task's key on the board (T-3) and the issue's in the tracker.

skipped.description: Tasks left out because they'd been sent before.

updatedAt.description: Epoch ms of its last change.

events.description: In the last 30 days: things done on it, people who opened it, and model tokens spent on it.

providerId.description: The connection, or null if it's since been removed.

cost.description: In the workspace's own currency units, from the prices an owner set; null without them.

confirm.description: The workspace's name, typed out, to be sure.

id.description: Null once their account is gone.

nodeId.description: The note or frame's id in the board's document (it may since have been deleted); a pin's is "<image id>@<pin id>".

anchor.description: Where a pinned comment sits on its image.
Starting a comment pinned to a spot on an image: where. Kept from the thread's first comment.

role.description: What the person asking may do on this board.

folderId.description: The workspace folder it's filed in, if any.

starred.description: Whether the person asking starred it, and when they last opened it.

continuesId.description: The board this one carries on from, if it was started as its next session.

columns.description: Its columns' titles, left to right.

template.description: A template to start from (see GET /board-templates); without one, a blank board.

title.description: The new board's title; by default the last one's, numbered up ("Sprint 13 retro").

boardRole.description: Set on this board, replacing the workspace role; null when it follows the workspace.

role.description: What they may do here; null when they can't open the board.
A role for this board only (`none` keeps them out), or null to follow their workspace role.

snippets.description: Matching passages as HTML-escaped text, with the matches wrapped in <mark>.

token.description: Goes in the link the person is sent: /invite/{token}.

priceInPerMillion.description: What the workspace pays per million input and output tokens, if an owner has said.

label.description: What people see in the model picker, e.g. "Claude" or "Llama on our GPU box".

baseUrl.description: Required for OpenAI-compatible servers; for Anthropic, only to go through a proxy.

apiKey.description: Stored encrypted; omit for servers that need none (a local Ollama).

priceInPerMillion.description: Prices per million tokens, for estimating spend; null clears one.
Prices per million tokens, for estimating spend; null clears one.

status.description: What the test found: it works, or which part is at fault.

message.description: The model's reply, or what went wrong.

modelId.description: Which of the workspace's models to ask.

instruction.description: What the person wants: a question about the board, or something to do on it.

noteIds.description: Notes to focus on (a selection); without them, the whole board.

history.description: The conversation so far, oldest first, without this message; for follow-up questions.

reply.description: The model's answer, for the person who asked.

framesAdded.description: Frames the model made, to group notes or hold action items.

notesMoved.description: Existing notes the model moved into frames.

citedNoteIds.description: Notes the answer is about, most relevant first, for the person to find on the board.
